newsitem.title: USA: Bio-Logic sees Q4 EPS $0.06-$0.09 range.
newsitem.headline: Bio-Logic sees Q4 EPS $0.06-$0.09 range.

text.p: Bio-Logic Systems Corp said Thursday it expects to report earnings for its fiscal fourth quarter ended February 28 in the range of $0.06 to $0.09 per share, up from $0.03 per share in the year-ago period.
"We'll be between $0.06 and $0.09 for the fourth quarter versus $0.03 a year ago," said chief executive Gabriel Raviv in an interview with Reuters.
The maker of medical diagnostic equipment said it expects earnings for the fiscal year to be above $0.15 per share, compared to $0.21 per share last year.

Raviv said Bio-Logic projects fiscal 1997 revenues to come in slightly below $15 million, versus $14.6 million in fiscal 1996. "We'll be just under $15 million (in revenues) for the year. And we'll be above $0.15 a share for the year versus $0.21 last year," Raviv said, adding the company expects to report final fourth-quarter and year-end results next week.
As for the current first quarter, Raviv said, "We're definitely going to have a better quarter than the year before."
Bio-Logic is ramping up sales and production of its new AuDX hearing test device, which was launched last month.

The AuDX is a hand-held device that tests the acoustics of the inner ear with sound waves. Meant as a screening device for finding people who might need more thorough hearing exams, the AuDX is especially well-suited for use with children who cannot understand traditional hearing tests, Raviv said.
Bio-Logic makes other hearing test devices, as well as devices for intraoperative monitoring, sensory and sleep disorder testing and electroencephalography.
